_about: Military Occupational Classification (MOC) → O*NET-SOC crosswalk, slimmed for the CER/Sierra veteran-pathway bridge (MOC → SOC → certifications via the COS registry's occupation filter → CER cos_cert_id anchors). Synced by kb/_sync_moc_crosswalk.py on a GitHub Actions runner (moc-crosswalk-sync.yml) — the agent sandbox cannot reach onetcenter.org. Tracker-internal pending a served-consumer decision; display requires the attribution below.
_attribution: MOC↔O*NET-SOC crosswalk: U.S. Department of Labor, O*NET (onetcenter.org, CC-BY 4.0). Related certification data: CareerOneStop (careeronestop.org), sponsored by USDOL ETA; maintained by Minnesota DEED.
